title: Mochizuki Honami — Test Of Courage 2?!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: After school
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Vacant Classroom

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Phew... We managed to make it to the meeting on time.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I thought for sure we were going to be late because of how long that assembly was taking.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Anyway, why don't we sit over in those empty chairs there?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, let's.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What do you think we'll be doing today?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hmm... We took care of the flower beds in the courtyard last time, so if we follow the same schedule as last year...

rows.Speaker: Cleanup Committee Member
rows.Line: Alright, I'd like to get this meeting started.

rows.Speaker: Cleanup Committee Member
rows.Line: Many flowers are blooming beautifully now because of the wonderful work you did with their beds last time.

rows.Speaker: Cleanup Committee Member
rows.Line: So, just like last year, I'd like for us to pick a few flowers to put in vases to display around the school.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh... Does that mean we get to choose the flowers?

rows.Speaker: Cleanup Committee Member
rows.Line: I'll be assigning you all your own locations, but you'll only have a limited time to choose which flowers you'd like to use. The vases are stored in...
Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, let's try choosing from this bed.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I see flowers displayed around the school from time to time, but I didn't know that the cleanup committee was responsible for them.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I always thought they were pretty, but never really considered who was placing them there...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The cleanup committee comes to school very early in the morning to do it, so it makes sense that you wouldn't notice.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Also, different flowers bloom during different parts of the year, so we can't keep the school decorated year-round.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But for that very reason, I'd like to choose a flower that will help brighten up everyone's day, even just a little bit.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I also want to do my best to choose a flower that everyone will think is beautiful!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, let's both do our best!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hmm... There really are a lot of different types here. I'm having trouble choosing...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: How do you always pick them, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Well, I try to think about how people will feel when they see them...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: How they're going to feel...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: For example, these pink petunias are very cute, so they would cheer people up a little...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: On the other hand, this violet scarlet sage has a bit of a calming quality to it.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Right... It is important to think about what people will feel about them.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: In that case, I want everyone in school to see just how cute flowers can be...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, you have your choice of the petunia I just mentioned... Oh, or those white pansies over there!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow... Their petals are so adorably tiny!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay, I've made my decision. I'm choosing pansies. Thanks for the advice, Honami.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I hope everyone sees why you chose them, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Me too!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Have you already made your decision, Honami?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I have a list of candidates, but I'm having trouble choosing just one...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: The ones that look the most beautiful right now are the vervains, petunias and marigolds...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow, these marigolds have such a gorgeous color to them. Just looking at them makes me smile for some reason...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I agree. I feel like these can help me get through my least favorite subjects.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But it's also hard to say no to these petunias. I mean, they're just so cute. Which should I choose...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So... I just remembered some flowers Ichika told me about the other day, as well as what they symbolize. Petunias were among them...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Really? What do petunias symbolize?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: If I recall... They symbolize tranquility or peace of mind.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wow, that's so beautiful...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
So, I think I'll also go with the petunias.
Not only are they cute and pink...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: They symbolize the way I want everyone to feel. My hope is that these will be soothing and relaxing...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's really great...!
They're also a great reflection of who you are!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you.
Then, I think we're both decided.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: We're just making our choices today, right? We won't actually be putting them on display until later.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, but we'll need to get to school a little early... That being said, I'm sure everyone will appreciate seeing all these cute flowers everywhere.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: So, let's do our best to wake up early...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah!
